chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥafṣ ibn Sūqah, from one who informed him, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who approaches his wife from behind. He said: It is one of the two approaches; ghusl is required in it.

So it does not contradict the earlier reports, because this report is mursal and maqṭūʿ, in addition to being a solitary report. Something of this status cannot be used to oppose the musnad reports. Furthermore, it is possible that it was issued by way of taqiyyah, because it agrees with the doctrines of some of the ʿāmmah. Also, the liability is free of any obligation of ghusl, so the obligation of ghusl is not established upon it except by proof that yields knowledge. This report is from the solitary reports that do not yield knowledge nor warrant action, so acting upon it is not obligatory.

key_terms.أَخْبَارِ الْآحَادِ: solitary narrations that do not by themselves yield certainty
key_terms.التَّقِيَّةِ: dissimulation or precautionary expression under sensitive conditions
key_terms.الذِّمَّةَ بَرِيئَةٌ: the presumption that one is free of legal liability until proof establishes obligation
key_terms.الْأَخْبَارُ الْمُسْنَدَةُ: reports with connected and attributed chains of transmission
key_terms.الْغُسْلُ: ritual bath required after certain acts of sexual discharge or intercourse
key_terms.خَبَرٌ وَاحِدٌ: a solitary report transmitted through limited channels
key_terms.مَقْطُوعٌ: a disconnected report lacking complete transmission continuity
key_terms.مُرْسَلٌ: a report with a missing link in the sanad/isnad

ai.seo_question: Can a solitary and disconnected hadith establish the obligation of ghusl in marital relations?
ai.summary: This passage presents a report about ghusl being required in a particular form of marital intercourse, then argues that the report does not stand against stronger earlier narrations. It classifies the report as weak in transmission and possibly issued under taqiyyah, and therefore not sufficient to establish a legal obligation.
